scene: Lowering your telescope, three transport couriers pull up across the platform.
picture: A flat rooftop platform under starry night skies. On the far left, a red pneumatic mail train sits with open hatch. Standing left-centre, the player in burnt-orange jacket rests his telescope. In the centre idles a yellow tow truck. On the right, a courier waves from a sidecar motorbike.
shown: a tubular red mail train waiting on tracks on the far left
a flatbed tow truck idling in the centre with its door ajar
a green motorcycle with an empty striped passenger sidecar on the right
